title: Evaluation under gate-preserving replacement
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $b$ be either true or false, let $x$ be an assignment to the $n$ Boolean variables, and let $f$ map circuits to circuits. If $f(c)$ and $c$ have the same value under $x$ for every circuit $c$ in a finite list, then replacing each list entry $c$ by $f(c)$ leaves the value of the gate with connective $b$ unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A nonnegative integer number of variables
Every circuit in the list is evaluation-preserved by the map
